verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal runs online filing services and a public website, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack covers only patent, trademark and design procedures and an llms.txt probe. Nothing in it mentions telemetry, cookies, analytics, or any tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
